provenance.prompt:
Edit Image 1 only as a tightly constrained Dino Atlas anatomy repair. Preserve the exact existing 16:9 composition, camera, animal identity, paired crests, skull, eyes, mouth, neck, torso, skin pattern, lighting, environment, both hind legs and feet, far forearm and far hand, pelvis, and complete tail. Do not redesign, reframe, mirror, crop, recolor, or add any animal.

Repair only the foreground/near forehand on the viewer's right side of the animal, using Image 2 as the approved Dilophosaurus four-digit-hand anatomy control. That near hand currently reads as only three large clawed digits. Keep its three existing longer functional curved clawed digits I–III, and add exactly one much smaller lateral peg-like digit IV attached naturally at the outside of the same hand. The new fourth digit must be short, blunt, visibly smaller than I–III, and have no large claw. Isolate it clearly against the pale sand so the near hand can be counted as three large clawed digits plus one tiny blunt IV. Do not add a fifth digit, do not change the far hand, and do not create four equal claws.

Result must remain exactly one adult Dilophosaurus wetherilli with two separate crests, two forelimbs, two hind limbs, and one tail. No text, logo, watermark, blood, prey, movie frill, or venom. Natural-history realism, original project artwork.
